test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**1) VZ-TX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b43d43a763a8ec5970caab1e79878230e5e9ee3665b4fa350bff778a2bc2435d.png] 

2) GK-ZD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a94f64d89ba002af2483b48852c0ad55172a6166a83815165374a6b8805a663.png] 

3) CG-VZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a019330ec025b297db086038e1c5f3d9b2a90c23e2be4aa3ae1c54e76a77df9e.png] 

4) WA-PT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d824e95b661ef81ef31d550606c359089a7857e5c31f12c50ff1fb2e7ca9a25.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**VZ-TX"**.
